rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial noun for leather as a material or for a piece used in polishing when the context is clear.

example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 pei4 daai3 hai6 zan1 pei4 gaa3

rows.note: Use this more formal material term instead of 皮 when discussing leather as a manufactured substance.

example.english: This leather passed the abrasion test.
example.traditional: 呢款皮革通過咗耐磨測試。
example.jyutping: ni1 fun2 pei4 gaak3 tung1 gwo3 zo2 noi6 mo4 cak1 si3

rows.note: Use this for leather jackets or similar leather outerwear, especially biker clothing.

example.english: They often wear leather jackets when riding motorcycles.
example.traditional: 佢哋踩電單車嗰陣成日着皮褸。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 caai2 din6 daan1 ce1 go2 zan6 sing4 jat6 zoek3 pei4 lau1
